{{Quote|Master Lysannis, as you know, your alleged girlfriend, Mistress Daria Felton, failed to corroborate your alibi.|Dragen|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Daria Felton''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] who lived on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. She was the girlfriend of [[Rikael Lysannis]], and she testified against her boyfriend to the [[Justicars' Brigade]]. She was unable to corroborate his alibi, which resulted in Rikael's confession that he in fact did work for [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]].
